title: Saturated readouts with complete signed/balanced integration: conditional κ = 6.398282083297e-5
body:
Full verification PASSED on `01c39ee9bdc9da298f68e8a424bb2a8ad5574d73` in 3612.794 seconds, completed 2026-10-09T00:10:56.566581+00:00. This includes `make -j1 verify`, all 78 isolated test modules, the explicit package replay and controls listed in [validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/saturated-balanced/research/saturated-balanced/validation.json), with no source drift. All 45 research-head GitHub checks passed.

This composes **Divjot Singh Manchanda's PR99 nondegenerate readout saturation**, **Zhihao Chen's PR97 complete reflected/signed interfaces**, and **PR100's balanced positional transfer**. The conditional result is:

**κ = 6398282083297/10^17 = 6.398282083297×10⁻⁵**, approximately **0.00609757% above PR100**.

This is effectively the same numerical value as PR99's alternative A–E transfer, not a substantial numerical improvement over that alternative headline. The contribution is a complete reproducible integration with the retained signed/balanced interfaces, including fresh physical replay and an independently enclosed exact certificate.

The physical change belongs to PR99: 22 readout frames expand by 25 dimensions. Its rank-preserving full histogram delta removes 177,100 singleton children. Width 108,516,254, recursive rank 57,403,754,177, 28,866 auxiliary roles and 32,408 complete ordinary/dirty basis columns are retained. No further frame modification is claimed.

Chen's original complete forward/reflected bit ledger is rerun on those exact frames, rather than substituting a saved scalar result. The unchanged signed complex ledger, dense identity, gauge/tensor controls, translation and inverse rank-one correction are also replayed. All endpoint, copy and intermediate-gate charges remain present. PR99's independent rational frame review and full native geometry/scalar checks passed separately; full mode reproduces them with the integration.

The bit saving is **31993457448237/500000000000000000**. The complex saving remains **36926111/500000000000**. Two independent exact moment enclosures, next bit/κ grid rejections, all 47 strict constraints, seven margins, eventual cutoff comparisons and six new adversarial controls pass. The stronger balanced result explicitly depends on the inherited paid positional-layout construction; an old-prefix negative control rejects those same parameters.

```sh
python -m pip install sympy==1.14.0
python research/saturated-balanced/verify.py
python research/saturated-balanced/test_controls.py
python research/saturated-balanced/verify.py --full
```

All PR99 source files are vendored unchanged, with their manifest, Apache license and notices. Generated outputs go to disposable directories. This is a conditional finite witness, not a new fully formal theorem, measured speedup or global optimum. See `research/saturated-balanced/PROOF.md` for the argument and review boundaries.
